headline: Argentina approves RIGI investment framework for Vaca Muerta gas infrastructure
summary: The Argentine government officialized approval of the RIGI framework for a $50.75 billion investment across multiple stages to expand Vaca Muerta gas processing and transport infrastructure.
why: Large-scale energy infrastructure investments aim to boost production capacity and facilitate international export streams for hydrocarbon-rich regions.

impacts.name: Energy Sector
impacts.why: Significant capital expenditure supports asset development and future production capacity.
